giris1: Once upon a time! Feza smiled while reading his book on the toilet. Bilbo wagged his tail beside him. A colorful dream sprang from the page!
kahraman_sec: Which Feza will you be today? Choose the warrior, the wizard, or the magic knight with a sword and a wand!
seviye_buyu: Level up! Your magic wand is stronger now!
giris_hibrit: A light sword in one hand, a magic wand in the other! Tap nearby grumps with your sword, and send magic to those far away!
seviye_hibrit: Level up! Your sword and magic wand are stronger now!
hibrit1: Crescent Wave is ready! Send a magic crescent from your sword to cheer up the grumps ahead!
hibrit2: Light Bond unlocked! Magic swords will circle around you, protecting you and sending light to nearby grumps!
hibrit3: Rainbow Seal is ready! Bring your sword and wand together and let waves of colorful magic shine!
giris_buyu: Send light from your magic wand to cheer up the grumps from far away! Touch where you want to go.
degnek: You found a new magic wand!
buyu1: Light Arrows are ready! Press the purple button to send three magic arrows from your wand!
buyu2: Frost Blossom unlocked! Use the blue button to freeze the grumps for a moment while your magic shield protects you!
buyu3: Star Garden is ready! Press the pink button and let the stars circle around to cheer up the grumps!
giris2: Tap the grumps with your light sword to make them happy again! Touch where you want to go.
yolculuk: All the worlds on your dream map are waiting for you! Choose any world, explore and play with Bilbo, then visit another dream!
baykus: I am the Wise Owl! I flew here from the dream book. Follow the shining path, and drink a red potion if your health gets low!
orman: The Green Forest Dream! Huge trees, smiling jellies and mushrooms are waiting for us!
kefir: The Kefir Valley Dream! Rivers of milk are flowing. The yogurts and cheeses are having a party!
ilk_kaymak: Clotted creams are sliding this way. Watch out!
magara: The Crystal Cave Dream! Sparkling stones shine all around. Moles and snails are playing hide and seek here!
ilk_kostebek: Look! Moles are popping out of the ground!
ilk_salyangoz: The snails are blowing bubbles. Watch out!
yanardag: The Glowing Mountain Dream! Orange rivers of light are shining. Squishy turtles are ready for a game of lights!
ilk_ateskusu: Firebirds are flying. Watch out for the sparks!
sehir: The Festive City Dream! Street lanterns are shining. Bagel sellers, drummers and guards are all playing together!
ilk_nobetci: The guards are blocking the path! They don’t want anyone to pass.
ilk_simitci: Look! The bagel seller is tossing bagels!
ilk_supurgeci: The sweepers are coming in a cloud of dust. Watch out!
ilk_tellal: The town crier is beating his huge drum. Step back when you hear it!
kale: The Friendly Dragon’s Castle Dream! Colorful towers are waiting for us. The dragon wants to share the joy crystal with his friends!
yetenek_yildiz: New skill: Star Shot! Press the star button to throw a star at distant grumps!
yetenek_kasirga: New skill: Whirlwind! Press the new glowing button and spin, spin, spin!
yetenek_meteor: New skill: Meteor Shower! Press the new glowing button and let star stones rain from the sky!
seviye1: Level up! You are even stronger now!
seviye2: Another level! You are amazing, Feza!
seviye3: Level up! Your light sword is stronger now!
kilic: You found a new light sword!
sapka: A new hat! It looks great on you!
pelerin: A new cape! It’s fluttering in the wind!
sandik: A treasure chest! Let’s see what’s inside!
can_az: Your health is low! Press the red potion!
iksir_yok: You’re out of potions. Collect hearts to heal!
yoruldu: Feza is a little tired. We’ll rest and come right back!
nese_tasi: The joy stone is shining! If you get tired, you can continue from here.
kapi: A magic doorway! Step inside and let’s go somewhere new!
kocaman: Watch out! A giant grump is coming!
kraljole_giris: Here comes King Jelly! Watch the ground when he jumps!
kraljole_tac: Look! King Jelly dropped his crown. Run and grab it!
kraljole_saskin: You gave his crown back! King Jelly is surprised. Go on, tap him!
kraljole_bitti: King Jelly is so happy! The magic doorway to Kefir Valley is open!
kefirdev_giris: Here comes the Bubbly Kefir Giant! He sprays foam when he shakes. Watch out!
kefirdev_balon: A giant foam bubble is coming! Hit it and pop it!
kefirdev_hik: The bubble popped! The Kefir Giant has the hiccups. Now’s your chance!
kefirdev_bitti: The Kefir Giant is bubbling with laughter! He offers Feza a glass of kefir.
kefir_ikram: The Kefir Giant shared his very best kefir with you. Enjoy it, Feza!
kefirdev_yol: The Kefir Giant is blowing another dream! A sparkling crystal cave lies beyond the bubbles. The new doorway leads there!
usta_giris: Master Mole is here! Hit him as soon as he pops out of the ground!
usta_saklambac: Master Mole is playing hide and seek! Run to the shining hole, and tap him when his head appears!
usta_yakaladin: You caught him! Master Mole is dizzy!
usta_bitti: Master Mole has a great big smile! The doorway to the volcano is open!
kaplumbaga_giris: The Giant Lava Turtle! Stay away from the glowing circles on the ground!
kaplumbaga_tas: Cool stones have appeared! Hide behind one when the turtle rolls!
kaplumbaga_devrildi: The turtle bumped into a stone and tipped over! Now’s your chance!
kaplumbaga_bitti: The turtle gave a great big smile! The lights on its shell became lanterns in the festive city. A new dream doorway is open!
sovalye_giris: Here comes the Grumpy Knight and his huge horse! He shows his path before charging. Step aside!
sovalye_sancak: Hit the banners! When they all fall, the knight will get dizzy!
sovalye_havuc: Look, a carrot! Pick it up and feed the horse when it comes!
sovalye_atdoydu: The horse loved the carrot! The knight is waiting. Now’s your chance!
sovalye_bitti: The knight and his horse are so happy! The festival flags became a rainbow. The path leads to the friendly dragon’s castle!
ejderha_giris: Here comes the Grumpy Dragon! Come on, Feza, let’s cheer him up too!
ejderha_yarim: The dragon is getting tired! Keep going, you’re almost there!
ejderha_yumurta: The dragon laid new eggs! Touch them and tiny dragons will hatch.
ejderha_kalp: The dragon blew hearts into the air! Collect the flying hearts!
ejderha_sevgi: You collected all the hearts! The dragon received a great big heart of love.
ejderha_bitti: The dragon is laughing! The joy crystal shines for Feza and Bilbo. All the dream friends are happy together!
kristal: The joy crystal! Touch it and let all your dream friends’ laughter turn into stars!
son: What wonderful dreams you imagined, Feza! Touch any world on the map to play again with Bilbo!
tekrar: The dreams are starting again! You can also use the map button to visit any world you like.
hos_geldin: Welcome back, Feza! Your adventure continues right where you left off.
canta: Look in your bag! What would you like to wear?
basla: Press Play and let’s begin our adventure!
devam: Press Continue and pick up your adventure where you left off!
tuccar_merhaba: Look, it’s Murmur Moonlight, the traveling merchant! Spend your gold on little wonders.
tuccar_iksir: Fluffy Sip is in your bag. Drink it when your health gets low.
tuccar_bulut: Cloud Cloak will give you a little extra protection throughout this chapter.
tuccar_parilti: Your weapon is sparkling! It’s a little stronger now.
tuvalet: The Sparkling Bathroom Dream! Smiling little poops, yellow pee drops, and dancing soap bubbles. They all want to play!
ay: The Moon’s Star Garden! Pom-poms bounce, craters play hide and seek, and Earth waves hello!
kopukusta_giris: Bubble Master is having a bathroom party! Dodge the big bubbles and collect the shining soaps!
kopukusta_bitti: Bubble Master is laughing! He built a bubble rocket. Jump inside with Bilbo. Our next dream is the Moon!
roket_yolculuk: Feza and Bilbo climbed into the rocket. They’re flying through bubbles and stars to the Moon!
aytavsan_giris: Moon Bunny is looking for his stars! Watch the shining ground when he jumps, and bring him three stars!
aytavsan_bitti: Moon Bunny found his stars! A star leaf became a shuttle. Feza and Bilbo can climb aboard and fly to the Green Forest Dream!
mekik_yolculuk: Feza and Bilbo climbed into the leaf shuttle. Now they’re flying to the cheerful forest!
sabun_oyun: The soap dance! Run to three shining soaps so Bubble Master can’t stop laughing!
ay_oyun: The star collecting game! Run to three golden stars and let’s make a constellation for Moon Bunny!
hayal_oyun_bitti: All done! Your dream friend is tired from laughing. Now you can send some light!
ilk_kakacik: Look! Little poops in hats are bouncing with joy!
ilk_cisdamlasi: Yellow pee drops are sliding down tiny slides!
ilk_sabunkopugu: The soap bubbles are blowing colorful bubbles!
ilk_ayponpon: Moon pom-poms are soft as cotton. What a big jump!
ilk_yildizcik: Tiny stars are playing with bubbles of light!
ilk_kratercik: Our crater friend is peeking out to play hide and seek!
bilbo_kemik: The bone button is always ready! Toss Bilbo a bone so he can cheer up his friends with tiny nibbles!
